messages:
sahil: Heads up — hosted-usw2 GPU pool spike at ~09:12 UTC, p95 queueing jumped and the capacity dashboard started firing a bunch of alerts for pool-7 and pool-11. seeing admission throttles + proxy retries.
ops-bot: Alert: gpu_pool_saturation_usw2 triggered (severity: high) — affected: pool-7,pool-11 — p95_queue_ms: 1200 — active_alerts: 18 — runbook: <https://wiki.redwood/internal/runbooks/gpu-saturation>
linh: linking dashboard https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/abcd/gpu-pools?orgId=1&var-region=usw2 — looks like KV cache misses spiking too
tomas: can someone paste the admission-control query? want to verify if it's admission or just bursty enqueue
irma: prometheus snippet I used earlier:
```promql
sum(rate(admission_controller_rejected_requests_total{region="usw2"}[1m])) by (pool)
```
irma: results show rejections jumping at 09:11 for pool-11 specifically
sahil: pool-7 had a sustained p95 surge as well, but pool-11 is the hot one. suspect embedding workloads from tenant-337.
oliver: ran a quick check on running jobs: `curl -sS https://api.internal.redwood/v1/pools/usw2/pool-11/active | jq '.jobs | length'` -> 142 jobs
linh: suggestion: enable temporary overflow routing for low-priority embeddings to eu2 for the next 30m (`/routing/enable-overflow?from=usw2&to=eu2&priority=low`), cost caveat noted
tomas: +1 for overflow but we should also throttle tenant-337 rate limit at the proxy layer if feasible
sahil: agree. prefer throttling tenant at proxy first to avoid cross-region egress cost. can infra enact a soft cap (reduce burst tokens) for tenant-337?
oliver: I can patch rate-limit rule, will do a quick canary: `curl -XPOST https://api.internal.redwood/v1/rate-limits -d '{"tenant":"tenant-337","region":"usw2","limit":20}'` and monitor
ops-bot: Deploy started: rate-limit-update by oliver — job 6734
linh: monitoring grafana panels, adding annotation for the changes
irma: if throttling doesn't lower queueing in 5m we flip overflow routing.
sahil: FYI we also flagged alert noise — some panels are pegging due to stale node exporter metrics. follow-up: ops will silence noisy panels for 10m
oliver: rate-limit canary returned 200. initial drop in rejections seen after ~70s. will keep it for 10m and report
tomas: good call. logging shows tenant-337 had an anomalous seq-len distribution too — maybe a bad client SDK sending long contexts
sahil: action items: 1) oliver keep rate-limit canary for 10m and report; 2) linh prepare overflow routing (ready to enable) if no improvement; 3) ops to mute noisy dashboard alerts; 4) infra to open a follow-up to investigate SDK client behavior for tenant-337 (Irma)
irma: opening follow-up: https://issues.internal/redwood/INF-4921
sahil: thanks all. will update when we either see stabilization or flip overflow. :thumbsup:
